name: Spotlight dim
oneLiner: a screenshot floats in a window; the lights go down, a soft follow-spot swings in from the middle and irises onto one region, a faint beam falling into it, then the lit region peels off the page as a glass card with a lit edge and a deep shadow
say: when the speaker says 'ignore everything else, look at this': the lights drop on 'ignore', the spot lands and the card lifts on the word that names the part. Set rect to the region in % of the image
